name: Quvdlugiarsuaq
body:
QUVDLUGIARSUAQ MOTH
CR 8

The huge moth-like creature is bright white in color with mottled brown and black in its wings to blend in with its arctic environment.

XP 1,200
N Huge magical beast (cold)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, blizzard sight; Perception -3

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+4 Dex, +8 natural, -2 size)
hp 108 (8d10+64)
Fort +14, Ref +10, Will -1
Immune cold

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., burrow 10 ft. (ice and snow only), climb 15 ft., fly 60 ft. (good)
Melee bite +16 (2d6+15), 2 claws +11 (1d10+5)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon (60-ft. line, 8d6 cold damage, Reflex DC 22 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), crystalline dust

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 18, Con 26, Int -, Wis 5, Cha 1
Base Atk +8; CMB +20; CMD 34 (42 vs. trip)
Skills Stealth -4 (+12 in arctic environments)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Crystalline Dust (Su)

As a standard action, an adult quvdlugiarsuaq can flap its wings and release a crystalline, icy dust in a cylinder below it.

Any creature in the area must make a DC 22 Reflex save or be blinded and coated in the glittering dust that acts like the spell glitterdust.

Additionally, any creature covered in the dust takes a -2 penalty against cold effects and effects that deal cold damage. The dust can be removed as a full-round action, which also cures the blinding effect, or after 1 minute. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment arctic
Organization solitary
Treasure none

These beautiful, white moth-creatures hunt the arctic lands they call home freezing their prey with their cold breath before falling upon them with their mandibles and claws. They typically hunt reindeer, seals, or bears, but have been known to attack small groups of humanoids that enter their territory.
